scope: Couples the supplied EXP-J triangle/pentagon display motifs to the existing eight-address Tube Occupancy vocabulary inside a declared cube-view adapter. A deterministic transition display retains a local trace and renders its bounded DFT view until explicit reset.

owner_boards.digitized_values: Occupancy fractions and EXP-J ratios are approximate readings of the supplied boards; persistence and switch values use the visible Series XI summary table.

view_contract.cube: Eight Tube addresses occupy eight declared screen corners; this is a view adapter, not a cube-axis identity.
view_contract.trace: A deterministic local transition display retains visited Tube addresses until explicit clear.
view_contract.fourier: The DFT bars are computed from the retained display-address trace; they are not the historical JANUS FFT result and do not measure a physical spectrum.

claim_boundary: The lens reconstructs and couples supplied display grammars. Poster similarity, digitized values, a working cube projection, retained trails and a local DFT do not establish a shared physical Tube mechanism, intrinsic prime geometry, historical algorithm replay, predictive navigation law, new Study, Finding, Family, identity or relation.
